Name: Neo's Succulent Farm Redux
Author: NoraCharles
Description:
The lovely mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6378]Neo's Succulent Farm[/url] is now discontinued, but Neonix has given permission for it to be ported to Stardew 1.6. [b]I've converted it to Content Patcher, so it no longer requires Json Assets, Mail Framework Mod, or SpaceCore.[/b] I fixed a few typos and incorrect growth data for a couple of crops (i.e. the time they took to grow didn't match the seed description), but otherwise the content is the same as the original mod.

The mod includes 20 crops (5 fruit + 15 flower). You can buy the seeds (called "stems" in game) from Pierre, and you'll also receive some seeds in the mail from villagers (requires level 3 farming skill + 3 hearts of friendship with the NPCs).

Should be compatible with any other mods that add crops.

To install, make sure you have the latest version of [b]Content Patcher[/b]. Download & unzip this mod and place the folder [b][CP] Neo's Succulent Farm Redux[/b] into your Mods folder.

[b]If you were using the original version of this mod, be sure to sell or trash any seeds/succulents in your game, destroy any planted crops, and then uninstall the original mod before installing this new version.[/b]

If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086]Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory[/url], check out the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26671]compatibility patch[/url] created by JohnMarley2018!


[b]TRANSLATIONS[/b]

Translations are available for the following languages:
[list]
[*]Chinese
[*]French
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[*]Hungarian (Only item/seed names & descriptions are translated, not the letters from villagers)
[/list][b]If you are interested in providing a translation, [/b]please translate the i18n/default.json file and send it to me (using a site like [url=https://www.mediafire.com/]MediaFire[/url] or [url=https://pastebin.com/]Pastebin[/url]). I will include it in the mod with credit.
